verdict.rationale: Pulumi Policies is a first-party policy-as-code feature: guardrails are defined in code and applied across Pulumi-managed and other resources. Policy violations surface in pull request comments and checks, which gates changes before they are merged and deployed. missing for 10: explicit documentation that violations block a preview/update (enforcement levels, mandatory vs advisory), detail on how policies run during `pulumi preview`/`up`, independent or hands-on corroboration of blocking behavior.
